description: This file defines an abstract class 'ProtocolAdapterProvider' which provides an interface for loading protocol adapters dynamically at runtime within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for loading providers via reflection, retrieving protocol adapters based on user agents, and obtaining header translators. Additionally, it contains a nested static class 'Ignored' implementing 'HeaderDefinition' for headers that are ignored by Ditto.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProvider
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a factory and loader for protocol adapters and their header translators, with mechanisms for dynamic reflection-based loading.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterProvider.Ignored
classes.description: A static nested class that implements 'HeaderDefinition' for headers that are ignored by the Ditto framework.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a ProtocolAdapterProvider subclass using reflection based on class name provided in ProtocolConfig and Akka ActorSystem.

methods.name: getProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a protocol adapter suitable for the given user agent.

methods.name: getHttpHeaderTranslator
methods.description: Returns a HeaderTranslator instance tailored for the current protocol configuration.

methods.name: createHttpHeaderTranslatorInstance
methods.description: Abstract method to create a specific HeaderTranslator instance based on ProtocolConfig.
